mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, r.name AS restaurantName, r.logo_url AS restaurantLogo, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status AS status, o.created_time AS createdTime FROM orders o JOIN restaurant r ON o.restaurant_id = r.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND ( r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.dish_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY o.created_time DESC

SELECT r.name AS restaurant_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, -- 使用子查询计算总金额，避免重复计算 ( SELECT SUM(o2.total_amount) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.restaurant_id = r.id AND o2.status = 4 AND o2.created_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_items_sold FROM orders o JOIN restaurant r ON o.restaurant_id = r.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 4 AND o.created_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY r.id
